rituals.title: SHAPE OVERLAY
rituals.mission: Make two shapes create a third structure between them.
rituals.play: Picture a circle and a triangle. Slide the triangle partly across the circle and hold the overlap. Notice the regions belonging only to the circle, only to the triangle, and to both.
rituals.twist: Do not fuse the outlines into one new shape.
rituals.win: A new shared region appears without either original shape disappearing.
rituals.mind_bend: Two intact shapes can create entirely new regions simply by overlapping, revealing that some mental features belong to relationships rather than either object alone.

WIN

MIND BEND

rituals.mind_bend: A troubling image can retain its identity while losing almost all spatial size, showing that visual dominance and informational content are different properties.

rituals.win: Positive quality becomes discriminable through contrast.
rituals.mind_bend: Pleasantness and neutrality feel different partly because they are contrasted; alternating them exposes evaluation as relational rather than generated by each cue alone.

rituals.title: FALSE-CONSENSUS BET
rituals.mission: See whether your own choice quietly becomes your population estimate.
rituals.rule: Preference and prevalence are two separate answers.
rituals.play: Choose tea or coffee. Then estimate, out of 100 random adults, how many would make the same choice. Notice whether your own preference pulls the estimate upward.
rituals.twist: Keep the population estimate separate from whether your own choice is better.
rituals.win: Personal preference and assumed social prevalence become distinct judgements.
rituals.mind_bend: Personal preference can inflate estimates of how many other people agree, exposing false consensus as projection from ‘I choose this’ to ‘most people probably would too’.

rituals.rule: The punch passes through every folded layer.
rituals.play: Picture a square sheet folded in half, then in half again. Punch one mental hole away from the fold edges and unfold the sheet.
rituals.twist: Predict the full hole pattern before revealing it mentally.
rituals.win: One action on folded space expands into a symmetric pattern after unfolding.
rituals.mind_bend: One punch through a folded sheet becomes several holes after unfolding, revealing symmetry and layer overlap as rules that let a hidden final pattern be predicted.
